title: Expectation difference and failure probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a nonempty finite set, let $G\subseteq\Omega$ be nonempty, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ take values in $[0,1]$. The absolute difference between the uniform mean of $f$ on $\Omega$ and its uniform mean on $G$ is at most the fraction of elements of $\Omega$ outside $G$.
